patch_description:
This crossover version blends the stronger parts of the prior implementations while targeting the main failure mode: prediction collapse and slope decay in the validation regime.  
Key changes:
- Emphasizes short lookbacks (5–20 bars) and rolling z-score normalization to improve regime invariance.
- Adds regime-transition features such as volatility trend, efficiency trend, and momentum normalized by volatility.
- Keeps only robust interactions like momentum × volatility regime and volume × price pressure.
- Uses a slightly less constrained XGBoost setup to avoid mean-collapse while still controlling overfit.
- Keeps feature count comfortably below the 80-feature limit and uses only past data.
